scope: Polish one existing screen at a time. Show the result and wait for the user's approval before starting another screen.
preserve: Existing elements, features, controls and their order and positions
allowed: Visual polish without adding, removing, showing or hiding elements
Round icons and circular icon buttons
messages: Keep the original profile icon, title, search icon, camera icon, menu, Reels strip, conversation list, dividers and bottom navigation. Do not add a search input or subtitle. Keep the header icon buttons circular; do not turn the labeled New message action into an icon-only circle. Unread styling continues to follow actual unread state.
